scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run embed:kuni && npm run embed:luni
scripts.embed:kuni: npm --prefix ../kuni install && npm --prefix ../kuni run build:nested && rm -rf dist/kuni && cp -R ../kuni/dist dist/kuni
scripts.embed:luni: npm --prefix ../lunisurge install && npm --prefix ../lunisurge run build:nested && rm -rf dist/luni && cp -R ../lunisurge/dist dist/luni
